title: Separating signal from noise in coding evaluations
m3_title: OpenAI 拆解 SWE-Bench Pro 评测噪声问题
m3_summary: OpenAI 复盘 SWE-Bench Pro 等热门编程基准,指出评测数据存在噪声与可复现性危机,呼吁社区共建更稳健的代码 Agent 评估标准。
desc: A new analysis from OpenAI reveals issues in SWE-Bench Pro, a popular coding benchmark, raising concerns about reliability and accuracy in evaluating AI models.

title: Inviting hard questions
m3_title: Anthropic 公开征询 AI 治理硬问题
m3_summary: Anthropic 发起 Hard Questions 系列,公开向公众征集关于对齐、可解释性、长期利益的尖锐问题,承诺透明方式逐条回应,直面治理争议。
desc: We're asking the public for their hardest questions about AI, and committing to show our work as we address them.

title: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5
m3_title: Anthropic 发布 Claude Sonnet 5 编码与 Agent 旗舰
m3_summary: Claude Sonnet 5 在编码、Agent、专业级长链路任务上达到新前沿,定位中高价位主力模型,编程评测领先 GPT-5 系。
desc: Sonnet 5 delivers frontier performance across coding, agents, and professional work at scale.

title: Google DeepMind and A24 announce first-of-its-kind research partnership
m3_title: DeepMind 联手 A24 探索 AI 与电影跨界研究
m3_summary: DeepMind 与独立电影厂 A24 宣布首个 AI 影视研究合作,聚焦生成式工具对创作流程与故事讲述的影响,产出案例将公开。
desc: Google DeepMind and A24 announce first-of-its-kind research partnership.

title: Securing the future of AI agents
m3_title: DeepMind 提出 AI Agent 安全控制路线图
m3_summary: DeepMind 发布 AI Control Roadmap,把传统防护与实时监控结合,系统化应对 Agent 内部滥用、提示注入与权限升级等新型威胁。
desc: Securing internal systems with an AI Control Roadmap, combining traditional safeguards and real-time monitoring.

title: Jet-Long: Efficient Long-Context Extension with Dynamic Bifocal RoPE
m3_title: arXiv:Jet-Long 用动态双焦 RoPE 扩长上下文
m3_summary: 新论文 Jet-Long 提出动态双焦旋转位置编码,把长上下文训练成本砍半,推理延迟几乎不变,适配 RAG 与 Agent 长链场景。
desc: Jet-Long uses dynamic bifocal RoPE to extend LLM context cheaply, halving training cost with negligible inference latency, suited for RAG and long agent traces.

title: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench: Testing the Limits of Agents on Long-Horizon Terminal Tasks with Dense Reward-Based Grading
m3_title: arXiv:Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 测 Agent 长链极限
m3_summary: 新基准用稠密奖励取代稀疏终态评分,首次系统测出 Agent 在分钟到小时级终端任务中的真实能力上限,代码与数据全开源。
desc: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench evaluates AI agents on minute-to-hour terminal tasks with dense reward grading, exposing gaps masked by sparse final-outcome scoring.

title: Samsung Health app threatens data deletion if users opt out AI training
m3_title: 三星健康拒 AI 训练授权将清空用户数据
m3_summary: HN 281 分热帖:三星健康应用把关闭 AI 训练开关等同于删除所有健康数据,引发关于消费硬件 AI 默认开启与数据主权的激烈讨论。
desc: Article: Samsung Health app threatens data deletion if users opt out of AI training. HN 281 points, 70 comments.

title: Show HN: I implemented a neural network in SQL
m3_title: Show HN:工程师用纯 SQL 写完神经网络
m3_summary: Show HN 热帖:作者在 xarray-sql 库中用纯 SQL 实现了 MNIST 神经网络,展示把数组数据库与 ML 工作流统一在同一查询语言里的可能。
desc: xarray-sql now supports training a small NN in pure SQL against array data, demonstrating SQL as a unified ML/analytics surface.

title: feat: pass context to runTools callbacks (#1973)
m3_title: openai-node 改进 runTools 回调上下文传递
m3_summary: OpenAI 官方 Node SDK 提交 #1973,runTools 回调新增 context 参数,让多步 Agent 工具调用可携带会话级元数据,简化上层集成。
desc: feat: pass context to runTools callbacks (#1973) — openai-node now forwards per-call context to tool callbacks, easing multi-step agent orchestration.
